finishedText:
Case Note Date: 12/11

Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea were present during the visit. Mould was observed in the back bedroom again and is worse by the window. The landlord has not replied to two emails. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes missed the benefits form deadline last week, and a letter regarding this is on the table. The date of birth on the form is 3/3/87. 

It was agreed that the worker will ring the landlord on Monday, and she will post the form on Friday. Tomas Brandvold, who is a neighbour and also on the worker's list, offered to help with the form. 

The identified risk is rent arrears if the form is late. 

The next step is to revisit on 26/11.
